agentId.description: The agent's id, as list_agents answered it.

from.description: Where to read its transcript from where neither before nor after is given: end, the default, for its newest page, or start for its first, from the message it was started with.

before.description: The older place a page answered, to read the page of entries before it.

after.description: The newer place a page answered, to read the page of entries after it.

entries.description: At most how many entries of its transcript the page holds, such as 1 for what it last said or did; as many as fit in 16000 characters when left out.
